text_block_list.text: Morning. As I walked through the central plaza, cheers suddenly erupted from the Umamusume around.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall not go to the classroom today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case,
I shall check the lesson material with the teacher later.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If anything comes up, don't hesitate to lean on me.
I'll check in with you again around noon, okay?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Mhm.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
So this is the famous delicacy.
...Hmph. It looks exceedingly awkward to eat.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Right away. I'll slice it up for you in a jiffy.
Just give me a moment, okay?

And then, one day. While asking Dream Journey
about our upcoming regional expedition...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Orfe.
Are you awake?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Mm.
Going for a run.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see. Do you require a running partner?
If so, I can arrange one immediately.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
If Sister arranged it, it might prove entertaining.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu. In that case, I shall have everything in order in ten minutes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—My apologies. Thank you for waiting.
Now, were there any other questions...
choice_data_list: Man…… Being a big sister is tough, huh?
I'm fine. Hurry and go get ready for them.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Having a hard time?
Do you mean me?
choice_data_list: Yeah. You're always taking care of them, after all.
Yeah. You're always taking care of so many things.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
It seems there has been a misunderstanding.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—I am the one being forgiven.
By that beautiful sister of mine.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Looking after her.
...Serving her.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
She is a born ruler, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
All things considered.
—See? I really am a fortunate one...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you very much for your kind consideration.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then, if you will excuse me for a moment...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
That should take care of the arrangements for now.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I can't very well go troubling that child, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, not in the least.
...In fact, it is my heartfelt wish.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ensuring the reign of my sister, the queen, proceeds without impediment. ââAs her elder sister, that is all I desire.
